statements.action_statement: Base-layer package in the pinned Debian trixie image base with a fix shipped upstream after the pin. The decision is a fact about this exact package@version: any release whose image SBOM ships it is covered by derivation, and the version bump that arrives with the Renovate-refreshed base digest ends the coverage by construction — the rebuilt base either drops the finding or presents a new version for a fresh decision. Remediation is the next release on the refreshed digest (docs/release.md: remediation is never per-CVE); the lab fixture image is not deployed anywhere, so there is no live exposure to mitigate in the interim.
